استأذنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْذَنُوا (istaʔḏanū) /is.taʔ.ða.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
# اِسْتَأْذِنُوا (istaʔḏinū) /is.taʔ.ði.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
